2608.25657.title: Narcissus: Program Synthesis Using Context-Aware LLM Approximations
2608.25657.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at programming, but not when the task fixes the target language: prompted with a grammar rare in their training data, their programs usually break the grammar or fail the given specification. Enumerative synthesizers search the space of syntactically correct programs systematically guided by LLMs; the state of the art guides them by approximating LLM proposals into rule frequencies, which loses where each construct belongs and prunes every rule the proposals miss, exactly when the proposals are wrong. We present Narcissus, a synthesizer that keeps the proposals as syntax trees and scores each expansion of a candidate program in its context: does a proposal with the same surrounding structure continue the same way, and does the expansion rebuild a fragment the proposals repeat? A regularization term keeps every rule reachable, so wrong proposals delay the solution but cannot hide it. Across five domains and two search backends, Narcissus beats static guidance at every budget and consistently outperforms re-prompting the LLM to fix its own proposals; it reaches proposal-like programs an order of magnitude sooner and solves $40\%$ of ARC tasks where the raw proposals solve $13\%$, all without a single LLM call during search.
2608.25657.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在編程方面表現優異，但當任務固定目標語言時卻不然：當面對訓練數據中罕見的語法時，它們的程序通常會違反語法或未能滿足給定的規範。枚舉合成器系統性地在語法正確的程序空間中搜索，並由LLMs引導；目前的技術通過將LLM提議近似為規則頻率來引導它們，這會丟失每個構造所屬的地方，並修剪掉提議錯過的每條規則，正是在提議錯誤的時候。我們提出了Narcissus，一個保持提議為語法樹的合成器，並在其上下文中對候選程序的每次擴展進行評分：一個具有相同周圍結構的提議是否以相同的方式繼續，並且擴展是否重建了提議重複的片段？一個正則化項保持每條規則可達，因此錯誤的提議會延遲解決方案，但無法隱藏它。在五個領域和兩個搜索後端中，Narcissus在每個預算下都超越靜態指導，並且始終優於重新提示LLM以修正其自身提議；它在達到類似提議的程序上提前了一個數量級，並解決了$40\%$的ARC任務，而原始提議僅解決了$13\%$，在搜索過程中沒有進行過一次LLM調用。
